instruction: You're facing towards the bed, now slightly turn right and walk a few steps forward and exit the bedroom through an open white door, once you exit that white open door, you can find another white door open in front of you, walk through that door, go straight, now take right, and now you can see three paintings on the wall towards your left side, walk straight and you can see a wooden table onto your right side with a portrait  on to your right, now you can see an open white door in front of you, walk into the door and now your standing on a carpet and in bed in front of you and that is your final destination.
